claims.check: Lantern Trail is expressly invented and remains for two to four players.
The track runs from 1 to 12 and every pawn starts on space 1.
Every player starts with one lantern token.
The youngest player starts and turns proceed clockwise.
Each turn permits a normal one-space forward move or staying in place to collect one token.
Holdings are capped at three tokens; staying to collect is prohibited when already holding three.
The alternative paid move costs two tokens for three spaces forward, with payment before movement.
A paid move that would pass space 12 leaves the pawn in place and forfeits the spent tokens.
Reaching space 12 ends the game immediately, so a normal one-space move cannot pass it.
Pawns may share a space.
The first player to reach space 12 wins.
No dice are used.
